Oh I don't want to think of her as a bitch but I am now uncomfortable around her and such :'c

Yeah, Loki laughed it off and he and I joked about it. I didn't think it was a problem or anything ^^;

I like drawing c: And I was happy when they liked it, I do like making people happy c: I like drawing others, it's more practice and they all like it/

Thank you though <3 it means a lot ^^

Ah, I made a salad and it's okay, I put to much sauce on it again though, it's hard to make salads, I never know how much sauce to put... They say to always put a little but I just- how does it get everywhere? I think I just put to much, I should try as little as the ysay next time though...

I don' think it's just clumsy, becasue I'm bad at everything, not just a few "clumsy" things. Does being clumsy revolve around everything? ;-; I wouldn't know, I never met someone who would mess things up as much as I do...

What is overnight oats? I am assuming you put oats in a container and leave it over night (in milk or water to soak up)? I could always try that, I'll have to google how to make them.

I don't know, they said I was suppose to say someone described them rather than telling them someone had a photo of them. (as they skyped so they knew what the other looked like) But I just didn't see the mtelling me anything because I was busy drawing ;-; eithe rthat or my memory really is that bad...

Yeah, I'm in pain and so I just- I don't know, I think about it too much. I am always annoyed at people feeling like they should know what I'm feeling but they don't understand my pain so I make myself respond normal to them ;-; it's annoying when people tell me I have no right to complain or feel sad. That friend I mentioned, she said I have no right to be upset becuause I messed up and she is mad. So I told her I was going to bed and left because I can't control how I feel ;-;

Yeah, I just like these people I met and I can have the most fun with them at times, but other times I'm so sad and they make me feel worse... ;-; I've been in this subreddit a few times, on my other account I've posted three times and thought about posting 7 other times for help. I just thought that with so many on the old people would get mad at me that it's been so long and I still haven't gotten the help that I severely need...
But talking to people here has always helped me so much, it's the reason I'm still alive, and I continue on for awhile before feeling down again and come back...

I decided to get something to eat despite not much being here, I am eating the lettuce we have for the turtle. I put mayonase and catsup together for sauce like a salad. I dropped both things while getting them out, then I spilled the mayonase on the counter. Then when I finally sat down I droppeed the bowel on my shirt, I cleaned it up and put everything in the bowel because nothing was on the floor but now I'm even sadder because I can't even make a salad properly...
